snippet.title: Play Free: The Card Game Made for Twitch Chat | GhoulxCards Trailer
snippet.description:
GhoulxCards is a free card game made for Twitch chat. Every streamer's channel has its own card set: open packs, build a deck and play together.

Play free: https://cards.ghoulxghoul.com

What you can do:
- Open packs, free with channel points
- Adventure: fight through your streamer's maps
- Story mode: a whole pixel world to explore, with duelists, gyms and quests
- The New Land: a world of pets to tame, and pet battles against trainers
- Live raids: the whole chat vs one boss, on stream
- Raid drops: boss gear and 3 packs, one a Rare Booster
- Post-raid awards: MVP... or First to Fall
- Your pet fights beside you in raids and Adventure
- Through the Glass: a 2-player co-op adventure
- Collect them all, common to mythic, plus your streamer's custom cards
- Make your character: outfits, colors and pets
- Hang out in the Tavern, where chat pops up over your heads
- Packs every day: check in with channel points every stream

Watch us live on Twitch: https://twitch.tv/ghoulxghoul

Music: "Boss Battle #3 (8-bit re-upload)" by nene (CC0)
